title: Skill Composition for Legged Robot Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.14647v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robots, and humanoid robots in particular, are increasingly competent at individual behaviors, each obtained by training a specialized controller. A specialized skill is quick to train, converges reliably because the problem it faces is narrow, and can be validated on its own, none of which is true of a single end-to-end policy asked to cover everything. What remains fragile is the transition between them. We argue that the composition of independent sub-policies deserves to be treated as a research problem in its own right, rather than as an implementation detail left to whatever mechanism happens to be at hand. Reliable composition is what turns a collection of separate skills into a repertoire that can be used, extended and shared. translated_title: 足式机器人强化学习的技能组合
translated_abstract: 机器人，尤其是人形机器人，在单个行为上的能力日益增强，每个行为都是通过训练一个专门的控制器获得的。专门的技能训练速度快，因其所面对的问题范围较窄而能可靠收敛，并且可以独立进行验证——而这些特点都不适用于被要求覆盖一切的单个端到端策略。真正脆弱的地方在于技能之间的切换。我们认为，独立子策略的组合本身应当被视为一个值得研究的科学问题，而不是一个留给随手可用的某种机制来处理的实现细节。可靠的组合能够将一组彼此分离的技能转变为一个可被使用、扩展和共享的技能库。更根本的是，如果控制权能够安全地、在任何时刻于专门策略之间传递，那么机器人下一步该做什么的决策就可以被委托给一个性质完全不同的组件。
tldr: 本文主张将足式机器人独立技能策略之间的组合与切换本身作为一个核心研究问题，而非实现细节，通过可靠的技能组合将多个专门策略整合为一个可使用、可扩展、可共享的技能库。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that the composition of independent specialized skill policies, rather than the skills themselves, should be treated as a core research problem in legged robot reinforcement learning, turning a collection of separate skills into a usable, extensible, and shareable repertoire.
